Name: Duplicate Saves
Author: OMEGAlinc
Description:
Adds a button to duplicate save files directly from the load game menu.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/kxFc96g/compatibility.png[/img]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.14+.
Compatible with SMAPI 4.4.0+.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/d47w6r80/installation.png[/img]
Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
Put the DuplicateSaves folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
Load Stardew Valley using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].﻿


[img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxxPTf9/how-to-use.png[/img]
Go to the Load page in the main menu.
On the save you want to duplicate, hit the new button in the bottom right.
It will bring you to a new page to name the duplicate.
Then you're done! It will include everything from the original save.
